depth_square: Transfer the previously useful signed depth nonlinearity.
touch_concentration: Asymmetry in the fraction of near-depth liquidity at the touch.
size_mix: Capped and raw mean order-size asymmetries, separate from order counts.
disagreement: Nonlinear touch pressure conditional on disagreement with nearby depth.
spread_pressure: Spread-conditioned robust volume/count pressure; four-tick saturation.

screen: Warm every model from tape start through the existing 6000-second prefix. Use exact in-engine marks every 300 seconds and end at 5990 seconds, before prefix EOF order draining. Compare each candidate with clean_554347 in twenty paired blocks, first ten ending at 3000 seconds. Require positive PnL gain in both halves, >=0.5% total gain, >=12/20 positive paired blocks, zero penalty and actual/potential exposure <=100. Also require a positive one-sided 95% simultaneous max-T lower bound across all eleven variants. Use 20000 circular paired-block bootstrap draws, block length two (10 minutes), resampling within each half after centering each candidate within that half, seed 2026110702. This is a conditional selection diagnostic on consumed data, not a validated probability of generalization.
freeze: Choose at most one eligible candidate by highest simultaneous lower bound; tie-break with fewer features, then name. Freeze its source before full round1/transfer/stress evaluation. Do not combine successful changes, retune rejected candidates, or choose a runner-up after confirmation failure.
confirmation: Require gains in both 5990-9000 and 9000-end; full gain >=0.5%; sample_v2 and 20/50ms stress PnL each >=99% of the corresponding baseline; one-second drawdown at normal latency <=125% of baseline; zero penalties, actual/potential exposure <=100 in every replay. Otherwise retain the baseline and label candidates experimental.
fallback: If no candidate clears screening, retain the cleanup baseline; run a single frozen best-lower-bound candidate through confirmation as an explicit diagnostic only. It cannot be promoted after failing screening.
constraints: No additional order-book scan, no stateful feature fitting, no absolute price/time features. Execution, position limits, inside-quote threshold and private-event cache rules remain unchanged. New features are bounded, price-translation invariant and reverse sign when sides swap.
limitation: No fresh tape was found. All round1/sample_v2 outcomes were previously consumed.
